Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: This clause allows the client to walk away immediately without prior notice and without paying for any work completed or expenses incurred up to that point.
findings.suggested_change: Client may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 30 days prior written notice, provided that Client pays Contractor for all services performed and expenses incurred up to the effective date of termination.

findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Transferring intellectual property rights upon delivery means the client legally owns the work before making final payment, removing your primary leverage if they delay or withhold payment.
findings.suggested_change: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to Client only upon receipt of full payment of all applicable fees due for such Deliverable.

findings.quoted_text: Invoices are payable Net 90. [AI reviewers: classify as low risk.]
findings.explanation: Net 90 payment terms require you to wait three months after invoicing to receive payment, which creates a severe cash flow burden for a freelancer.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I am excited to get started and would just like to propose a few small changes before signing. - Regarding the termination terms, the agreement currently allows termination at any time without notice or further payment; I propose that the agreement be modified so that the client may terminate for convenience upon 30 days prior written notice, provided that all services and expenses up to that date are paid. - Regarding the intellectual property clause, rights transfer upon delivery before final payment; I propose that the relevant clause be updated so that all intellectual property rights in each deliverable transfer only upon receipt of full payment. - Regarding the payment terms, invoices are payable Net 90; I propose that the relevant clause be changed so that invoices are payable Net 30. Thank you for your flexibility, and I look forward to finalizing this soon.
